question: Dabur company founded year founding location and headquarters address
markdown:
Dabur was
founded in 1884 by Dr. S.K. Burman in Kolkata (then Calcutta), India
. The name "Dabur" comes from a combination of "Da" (derived from
Daktar
or Doctor) and "Bur" (from Burman). It began as a small, local-level enterprise providing affordable Ayurvedic medicines for diseases like malaria and cholera.
Wikipedia
Founder and Early Mission
Dr. S.K. Burman
: A physician with a degree in medical science, he wanted to make health care accessible to remote rural communities.
Initial Remedies
: He prepared and personally delivered custom Ayurvedic formulations for common and deadly illnesses.
First Plant
: Due to high demand, he set up a small manufacturing plant in West Bengal in 1896
Dabur
Evolution and Relocation
Research & Scale
: In 1919, his son set up a dedicated research unit to standardize Ayurvedic medicine production.
Move to Delhi
: In the late 1960s and 1970s, political and social changes in Calcutta led the family to shift operations to New Delhi (with corporate headquarters later moving to Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh).
Mass Market
: The company expanded into consumer goods like Amla Hair Oil, Chyawanprash, and Lal Dant Manjan.
